title: The Devil Is in the Reconstruction Loss Scale: Rethinking Optimization in LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.00983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods typically use sequential quantization that partitions a pre-trained LLM into a series of units (e.g., transformer blocks), with one unit quantized at each stage. State-of-the-art PTQ methods are predominantly learning-based, optimizing auxiliary quantization parameters (e.g., scaling factors, rotation matrices, clipping thresholds, and adapters) via gradient descent to minimize a reconstruction loss. A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. translated_title: 魔鬼藏在重建损失的尺度中：重新思考大语言模型量化中的优化
translated_abstract: 后训练量化（PTQ）方法通常采用顺序量化，即将预训练的大语言模型划分为一系列单元（例如Transformer块），并在每个阶段量化一个单元。最先进的PTQ方法主要基于学习，通过梯度下降优化辅助量化参数（例如缩放因子、旋转矩阵、裁剪阈值和适配器）以最小化重建损失。常见的做法是使用均方误差（MSE）作为重建损失函数，但其引发的优化行为在很大程度上尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们从整体视角审视顺序量化，并系统地研究了优化如何从第一个量化阶段演变到最后一个阶段，旨在深入理解基于学习的PTQ方案中的优化。通过对代表性基于学习的PTQ方法和大语言模型家族的广泛实证研究……
tldr: 该研究从整体视角系统探究了顺序量化过程中重建损失（如MSE）的尺度如何影响从第一个到最后一个量化阶段的优化行为，揭示了重建损失尺度是决定基于学习的LLM量化优化效果的关键因素。
